meta.name: short-drama-knowhow
meta.description: 维护者专用的短剧 know-how 学习、验证与生命周期治理。仅在维护者明确要求从其当前会话提供的授权只读文本源学习完整短剧项目链，并把私有观察逐步转成去标识、去复刻、经盲测与独立审查的公共 reference、rubric 或 synthetic fixture 候选时使用；不用于普通创作、公开运行时取数、媒体生成或粗略数据分析。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把私有短剧观察整理成可公开验证的参考资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有授权只读的短剧项目资料,想沉淀成可公开的素材。
copy.tagline_en: Turn private short-drama notes into de-identified public references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hold authorized short-drama material and want to publish safe reference assets

howto.what: 当你已授权只读文本源后,Claude 会按流程通读完整短剧项目链,写私有无标识卡片、建立覆盖矩阵、做盲测与独立审查,产出公共 reference、rubric 或合成 fixture 候选。
howto.when: 仅当维护者主动调用、且当前会话已提供授权只读文本源时接管,用于把私有观察转为公共候选;普通创作、公开运行时取数、媒体生成等场景不适用。

say.text: 我已授权这批只读剧本,请按项目链通读并写私有 observation card
say.note: 先产出私有无标识卡片,不写入公共技能包

say.text: 用这批样本建立题材×机制 coverage matrix,标出缺口和反例
say.note: 矩阵记支持卡、反例与缺口,不填频次

howto.what_en: With an authorized read-only source, Claude reads the full short-drama project chain, writes de-identified private cards, builds a coverage matrix, runs blind evals and reviewer checks, then drafts public reference, rubric or fixture candidates.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the maintainer explicitly calls it with authorized read-only text sources in the session, to turn private observations into public candidates; not for ordinary creation or media generation.

say_en.text: Read this authorized script set and draft private observation cards.
Build a genre × mechanism coverage matrix and mark the gaps.
say_en.note: Records support cards, counterexamples and gaps, not counts.

say_en.text: Send this candidate to blind eval and independent review before promotion.
say_en.note: No promotion if blind eval or review fails.
